decisions.reason: Locked identifier_link is right. cp 2454 is the target of the wikilink [[doi:10.2305/IUCN.UK...en|...]] in the hand-pasted cite inside ref 'مولد تلقائيا1' (1785-3287). The render turns it into a doi.org link to the same DOI. A DOI link inside a reference that points at the identifier is identifier_link (3.5). It is not display text (textual_mention) and not plain labelled text (labeled_reference_text).

corrected_label.notes: Link display fragment of the DOI 10.2305/IUCN.UK.2015-1.RLTS.T153568A74497730.en; the final '.' is part of the DOI (the same DOI continues in the next link displays), not trailing punctuation.

decisions.reason: Locked key '10.2305/iucn' strips the final '.' of the display text '10.2305/IUCN.' as sentence punctuation. 3.5 strips only trailing sentence punctuation that is not part of the DOI. Here the '.' is part of the DOI: the same DOI continues in the next two link displays ('UK.2015-1.RLTS.' and 'T153568A74497730.en') and in the wikilink target. Key is therefore '10.2305/iucn.' (ASCII lower-cased, valid form 10.<4 digits>/<suffix>, so not null). Role textual_mention stays (link display text). Ambiguity: the guide has no rule for a DOI split across several display links; I read this fragment as part of the DOI it belongs to.
